title: Generation Operators (Empty, Range, Repeat)
description: Learn to generate collections using Empty, Range, and Repeat operators.

data.text: LINQ includes generation operators `Empty`, `Range`, and `Repeat`. These are static methods in the `Enumerable` class, not extension methods.
The `Empty()` method returns an empty collection of a specified type.

data.title: Empty Example

data.text: The `Range()` method generates a collection of sequential integer values.

data.title: Range Example

data.text: The `Repeat()` method generates a collection with a specified number of elements, all containing the same value.

data.title: Repeat Example
Key Takeaways
points: Empty returns an empty collection of a specified type
Repeat generates a collection with repeated values
All are static methods in the Enumerable class
data.takeaway: Continue to the next lesson to learn about DefaultIfEmpty.
